text:
maria: New quant onboarding check failed on the holdout prompts — q4b-v2 (quant + cache) shows ~12% quality drop vs baseline on our golden set. cc @devon @labelops

devon: Can you paste the eval id and a couple diffs? Were these runs with cache enabled?

maria: Eval id: eval_2026_03_20_17. Command I used: ```rerun_eval --model q4b-v2 --prompts holdout_seed_03 --cache-enabled --batch 8```
Diff example: `prompt_id:8831 baseline_score:0.91 q4b-v2_score:0.72` — full diff artifact: https://redwood-internal/p/runs/ev/345 (private)

labelops: Label Ops here — we've noticed increased near-duplicate paraphrases in that holdout partition. Fuzzyhash collisions up ~3.2x. We can re-run dedupe with threshold=0.82 and send ~200 examples for manual micro-relabel.

jonah: ci-bot posted a perf trace earlier: `latency +8ms` when cache enabled for kv prefix len >64. Could be cache invalidation or wrong KV reuse on paraphrase mapping. @ana-ml can you check logits?

ana-ml: (ana-ml) I'll run a small A/B (cache on vs off) on the failing prompt ids and dump logits/topk for inspection. If stale KV frames are being reused across paraphrases that would explain both perf and accuracy regression.

maria: Thanks. Labelops — please tag the manual set with `golden-recheck-q4b` and prioritize anything with paraphrase overlap >0.85. Also include original+variant pairs in the payload.

labelops: On it. ETA ~6h for the 200 ex relabel. If relabel rate >10% we'll push a micro-golden update and re-evaluate.

devon: If relabel doesn't explain it, plan B: try int4 compile variant `q4b-v2-int4` with kernel patch r12 and run kernel-bisect to see if compilation codegen changed outputs. I'll also check batching heuristics (batch 8 -> try 4/16).

ana-ml: Summary plan: 1) labelops dedupe + relabel 2) I run cache AB + logits dump 3) devon runs kernel bisect + int4 compile check. Reconcile here after artifacts land. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: rerun_eval queued (id rerun_889). Expected results ETA ~20m.
